<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
cur=current_frame
# red nodes
reds=[n for n in cur.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='R']
for r in reds:
    rows=[p[0] for p in r['boundary']]
    cols=[p[1] for p in r['boundary']]
    print('red rows',min(rows),max(rows),'cols',min(cols),max(cols))
# water critical count
crit=0
for n in cur.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('w','g'):
        for r,c in n['boundary']:
            if r in (58,59) and c in (25,26):
                crit+=1
print('critical water cells',crit)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
